title: Jared Young's Collision with Mets Generates Concern in Stands
seoTitle: Jared Young Collision with Mets Sparks Concern
subtitle: Player was hit in the head by Nolan McLean during a play covering first base
excerpt: Mets first baseman Jared Young was taken to the hospital after being hit in the head by Nolan McLean in a chaotic play against the Phillies, causing a stir.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
In the sixth game between the New York Mets and the Philadelphia Phillies, the match was marked by an accident that forced Jared Young off the field. The first baseman was struck in the head by Nolan McLean as both attempted to field the same ball.

How the collision occurred

The play happened in the sixth inning when Phillies outfielder Justin Crawford hit a slow grounder toward first base. Young moved in to field the ball, while starting pitcher McLean tried to rush past his teammate. McLean's right knee struck Young's head, causing him to fall to the ground.

Immediate reaction from coaches and players

Mets trainers rushed to the scene, stabilized Young's neck, and carried him off on a stretcher. Shortstop Francisco Lindor described the moment as "scary." The team's manager, commenting on McLean remaining in the game, acknowledged that the decision could have been different, highlighting concerns for the player's well-being.

Jared Young's health status

Young was taken to a local hospital, where he underwent a computed tomography (CT) scan that came back negative. At the hospital, he exhibited concussion symptoms, but maintained full mobility in his limbs. The manager praised his initial recovery, stating that the player is showing "good signs" and that the team is optimistic about his condition.

Immediate impact on the team

With Young's departure, Mark Vientos took over defense at first base, going 1-for-2. Vientos has been capitalizing on the opportunity, especially against left-handed pitchers. The team may also turn to Brett Baty to cover the position, primarily against right-handed pitchers.

Repercussion among fans

As he was being carted off the field, Young gave a thumbs-up to the crowd, indicating he had regained consciousness. The audience responded with a supportive ovation, reflecting the fans' concern and affection for the athlete's situation.
